request.prompt:
Goods: Spark plugs for petrol engines
Country of origin: JP

Choose the chapter that covers these goods. Options:
- 85: Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles
    contains 851110: Ignition or starting equipment; spark plugs, of a kind used for spark or compression-ignition internal combustion engines
    contains 851130: Ignition or starting equipment; distributors and ignition coils of a kind used for spark-ignition or compression-ignition internal combustion engines
    contains 851120: Ignition or starting equipment; ignition magnetos, magneto-dynamos and magnetic flywheels, of a kind used for spark or compression-ignition internal combustion engines
    contains 851190: Ignition or starting equipment; parts of the equipment of heading no. 8511, for use in spark-ignition or compression-ignition internal combustion engines
    contains 851180: Ignition or starting equipment; n.e.c. in heading no. 8511, of a kind used for spark or compression-ignition internal combustion engines
    contains 851150: Ignition or starting equipment; generators n.e.c. in heading no. 8511, of a kind used for spark or compression-ignition internal combustion engines
    contains 851140: Ignition or starting equipment; starter motors and dual purpose starter-generators, of a kind used for spark or compression-ignition internal combustion engines
    contains 850220: Electric generating sets; with spark-ignition internal combustion piston engines
- 84: Machinery and mechanical appliances, boilers, nuclear reactors; parts thereof
    contains 840910: Engines; parts of aircraft engines (spark-ignition reciprocating or rotary internal combustion piston engines)
    contains 840991: Engines; parts, suitable for use solely or principally with spark-ignition internal combustion piston engines (for other than aircraft)
    contains 840999: Engines; parts for internal combustion piston engines (excluding spark-ignition)
    contains 840710: Engines; for aircraft, spark-ignition reciprocating or rotary internal combustion piston engines
    contains 840729: Engines; for marine propulsion, (other than outboard motors), spark-ignition reciprocating or rotary internal combustion piston engines
    contains 840721: Engines; outboard motors for marine propulsion, spark-ignition reciprocating or rotary internal combustion piston engines
    contains 840890: Engines; compression-ignition internal combustion piston engines (diesel or semi-diesel engines), of a kind used for other than marine propulsion or the vehicles of chapter 87
    contains 840820: Engines; compression-ignition internal combustion piston engines (diesel or semi-diesel engines), of a kind used for the propulsion of vehicles of chapter 87
    contains 840810: Engines; for marine propulsion, compression-ignition internal combustion piston engines (diesel or semi-diesel engines)
    contains 840731: Engines; reciprocating piston engines, of a kind used for the propulsion of vehicles of chapter 87, of a cylinder capacity not exceeding 50cc
- 87: Vehicles; other than railway or tramway rolling stock, and parts and accessories thereof
    contains 870360: Vehicles; with both spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine and electric motor for propulsion, capable of being charged by plugging to external source of electric power
    contains 870340: Vehicles; with both spark-ignition internal combustion piston engine and electric motor for propulsion, incapable of being charged by plugging to external source of electric power

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Spark plugs for internal combustion engines are specifically named in heading 8511 (subheading 851110) in Chapter 85.
